Ecosystem Platform / Capital, Talent & Hiring

Capital, Talent & Hiring

Twenty-one measures in two blocks — Capital measures (fifteen, on venture funding: availability, access, depth, market structure, continuity) and Talent and Hiring measures (six, on the workforce behind them and on hiring itself). Inside each block the Measure list is grouped, so similar measures sit together. Every measure is computed at country level; most are also computed at city and metro level. Choose a block and a measure to recolor the map, hover a beacon for context, click an ecosystem for its year-by-year values and construction notes, or open the Trend figure for a time-series chart of every location with the full data table underneath.

Data scope

The capital measures come from PitchBook — Tracxn, Zero2IPO, ATBD and Briter are not yet merged, so deal counts outside the US and Europe are understated. Most are built on venture-class deals; industry concentration, leading industry and time to IPO use the full PitchBook drop, which carries every deal class and the industry sector field. The talent and hiring measures come from the Revelio Labs panel of professional profiles and job postings, so they follow online professional coverage rather than firm registries. Thin cells are suppressed and every published value carries its n. The card under the map gives the selected measure's definition and caveats in short; Definitions & formulas gives every measure in full, with its formula.

Methodology

How the measures are made

Source

Two panels, one map

Capital measures aggregate a deal × investor extract from the full PitchBook feed (Deal, Company, DealInvestorRelation, Investor). VC deals only (DealClass = "Venture Capital", no deal-status filter); stages harmonized through the 261-label crosswalk; GDP from the World Bank. Talent and hiring measures aggregate the Revelio Labs panel — job postings for hiring demand, individual position histories plus the company panel for specialist density and the two talent flows. Which columns and filters feed each measure: docs/.

Geography

HQ country and HQ city

For capital measures, country = Company.HQCountry, city = Company.HQCity — municipalities, not metro areas (Palo Alto does not roll into San Francisco). Talent and hiring measures are located by where the work is, and their city values are Revelio metropolitan areas summed onto the same ecosystems — wider than the municipality, so the two families are not interchangeable at city level. The two GDP-denominated measures and international talent inflows are country-only and lock the level selector. Offshore financial domiciles (Cayman Is., BVI, Bermuda…) are excluded from display; they stay in the CSVs.

Conventions

Medians, windows, cohorts

Medians for every skewed variable (times, sizes, rounds), per the measure spec. "Active" definitions use a trailing three-year window; cohort measures follow companies for five years after their first round and drop right-censored cohorts. Investor density is expressed per VC/PE-backed company: PitchBook observes companies once they raise capital, so it does not support a full startup-population denominator.

Definitions, formulas and units: docs/platform_main_measures.pdf. Column-level provenance — tables, fields and filters behind each measure: docs/CAPITAL_measures_code.md, docs/TALENT_HIRING_measures_code.md and docs/UNICORNS_code.md. Prototype — PitchBook and Revelio Labs, not for citation.
